## What this does

Completes the append-only guard SEED-02 seeded: every remaining region mode,
a chain-id registry, first-parent replay, a register-derived replay oracle,
and a nightly read-only replay — so CI proves on every change that protected
build memory only grows.

1. **`docs/build/tools/memory_guard.py` — remaining modes.** `row-annotate`
   containment for DEFERRALS and protected ledger rows (OPEN FINDINGS /
   RETURN PASS: the old row's text must survive inside the new row;
   strike-through allowed); `placeholder-fill` for declared tokens in
   declared cells; `frozen-snapshot`; `frozen-after-execution` /
   `frozen-after-close` / `frozen-after-landing` (B2 §7); JSONL schema
   validity, `recorded_at ≤ commit UTC`, and prefix chaining to the
   obligation's last event. All entries under `record_policy/history.policy`.
2. **Chain-id registry** (B4 G2 amendment 4): a `git log -p` scan over the
   manifest chain table — an id that ever appeared never re-binds to a
   different file slug. The scan is cached in the report. A re-binding
   fixture fails.
3. **First-parent replay + oracle.** `memory_guard.py replay <span>` judges
   first-parent history commit-by-commit; `oracle-gen` derives
   `tests/unit/fixtures/memory_guard/replay_expected.csv` from the B1
   append-only register, the B2 date-corrections register (each class-b row
   re-judged for guard visibility under the policy in force at the
   introducing commit), and the 20 B4-G2 position-scan commits — never
   hand-copied counts (OM-15). Disagreements are adjudicated cell-by-cell
   and recorded in the oracle as `source=reviewed` waiver/violation rows —
   never silently re-baselined (B4). `seed-commit` policy directives
   (SHA-bound; the current checkout's registry merged into the judged
   revision's policy) let the Stage-B seed commits pass.
4. **Vacuous replay exits 3** (SIG-ENG-042): an empty span, or a non-empty
   span whose commits each evaluated zero candidates, is never green.
5. **Nightly read-only replay** in `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`:
   `fetch-depth: 0`, `replay <root>..HEAD --oracle replay_expected.csv`,
   JSON + per-stage log artifacts, wired into `nightly_report.py` as a gate
   stage.
6. **Fixtures:** `test_memory_guard.py` — 137 tests; pass + fail per mode
   plus B4's three (`307161ee` position, C6 living-archived pass, byte-off
   archive fail) and chain re-bind.
7. **C-10 / ADR-146:** `db/sqitch.plan` stays whole-file `append-only`;
   L44–52 pass only through keyed `allow` entries (expiring
   2026-10-19T21:00:00Z); `docs/build/planning/**` stays out of scope.
